name: Todos
description: Your todos on a screen made of Zeff's own kit: grouped by urgency, with the ones you wait on, done and the workers' — tick, flag, set aside, dismiss, a due day, add.

views.name: Todos
views.template:
<state name="part" value="todos" keep=true/><state name="scope" value="open" keep=true/><state name="filter" value=""/><state name="limit" value="50"/><state name="chips" value="[]"/><state name="omniq" value=""/><state name="feedfilter" value="all"/><state name="att" value=""/><state name="recapday" value=""/><state name="dueedit" value=""/><state name="dueval" value=""/><state name="newtext" value="" keep=true/><state name="newdue" value=""/><state name="newticket" value=""/><state name="panel" value=""/><state name="quick" value=""/><state name="acts" value=""/><state name="replytext" value=""/><state name="askq" value="" keep=true/><state name="jql" value=""/><state name="aq" value=""/><state name="busy" value=""/><state name="instr" value="" keep=true/><state name="opedit" value=""/><state name="optext" value=""/><state name="noteedit" value=""/><state name="notetext" value=""/><state name="tf_name" value=""/><state name="tf_iban" value=""/><state name="tf_bic" value=""/><state name="tf_amount" value=""/><state name="tf_purpose" value=""/><state name="textedit" value=""/><state name="edittext" value=""/><state name="newnote" value="" keep=true/><state name="mins" value=""/><state name="timenote" value=""/>
<data name="x" lambda="todos.screen" with="scope={{ state.scope }}, filter={{ state.filter }}, chips={{ state.chips }}, limit={{ state.limit }}" debounce="300" when="{{ state.part == 'todos' and state.scope != 'activity' }}"/>
<data name="hits" lambda="todos.hits" with="q={{ state.omniq }}" debounce="150" when="{{ state.omniq }}"/>
<data name="feed" lambda="todos.feed" with="filter={{ state.feedfilter }}" when="{{ state.part == 'todos' and state.scope == 'activity' }}"/>
<data name="seen" flow="todos-ext.seen" with="id={{ data.feed.max }}" when="{{ state.scope == 'activity' and data.feed.max }}"/>
<data name="lage" lambda="todos.lage" with="att={{ state.att }}" every="5" when="{{ state.part == 'todos' or state.part == 'tickets' }}"/>
<data name="day" lambda="todos.day" with="day={{ state.recapday }}" every="5" when="{{ state.part == 'recap' }}"/>
<data name="today" lambda="todos.heute" when="{{ state.part == 'today' }}"/>
<data name="men" lambda="todos.mention" with="text={{ state.newnote }}" debounce=250 when="{{ state.panel and state.newnote }}"/>
<data name="p" lambda="todos.panel" with="id={{ state.panel }}" when="{{ state.panel }}"/>
<data name="qp" lambda="todos.panel" with="id={{ state.quick }}" when="{{ state.quick }}"/>
<data name="asks" lambda="todos.asks" with="id={{ state.panel }}" every="3" when="{{ state.panel }}"/>
<state name="abusy" value=""/>
<data name="pick" lambda="documents.attach-list" with="q={{ state.aq }}" when="{{ state.panel }}" debounce="250"/>
<on event="attached" action="reload"/>
<data name="listseen" flow="todos-ext.list-seen" when="{{ state.part == 'todos' and state.scope == 'open' and data.x }}"/>
<on event="todos-changed" action="reload"/>
<sidebarframe store="zeff-todos-sidebar">
<sidebar>
<tabs bind="part" look=line options='[["todos","Briefing"],["tickets","Tickets"],["recap","Recap"],["today","Today"]]'/>
{{#if state.part == 'recap'}}
<line look=stack>
<line look=day>
<iconbtn glyph="←" label="Day before" tip="Day before" action="state" state="recapday" value="{{ data.day.before }}"/>
<line look=h2>{{ data.day.label }}</line>
{{#if data.day.after}}<iconbtn glyph="→" label="Day after" tip="Day after" action="state" state="recapday" value="{{ data.day.after }}"/>{{/if}}
<datepick bind="recapday" max="{{ data.day.max }}" label="Jump to a day"/>
</line>
{{#if data.day.facts}}<line look=mono>{{#each data.day.facts}}<ink>{{ text }}</ink>{{/each}}</line>{{/if}}
</line>
<line look=run>
{{#if data.day.running}}<line look=status><ink tone=pulse></ink>{{ data.day.runningText }}</line>{{/if}}
<pill look=primary run="todos-ext.recap-start" with="day={{ data.day.day }}" into="rran" emit="todos-changed" disabled="{{ data.day.running }}" tip="Gathers what you did that day (entries, todos, workers, Jira, commits, GitLab) and has the AI from the settings summarize it">{{ data.day.running ? 'Running…' : data.day.again ? 'Summarize again' : 'Summarize' }}</pill>
{{#if data.rran.error}}<line look=error>{{ data.rran.message }}</line>{{/if}}
</line>
{{#if data.day.failed}}<line look=alert>{{ data.day.failed }}</line>{{/if}}

{{#else}}
<line look=head>
<line look=grow>
<line look=h1>{{ state.part == 'tickets' ? 'Tickets' : 'Todos' }}</line>
{{#if data.lage.asOf}}<line look=small>{{ data.lage.asOf }}</line>
<line look=chips>{{#each data.lage.facts}}<ink tone=chip>{{ text }}</ink>{{/each}}</line>{{/if}}
</line>
<line look=shrink>
<line look=run>
{{#if data.lage.running}}<line look=status><ink tone=pulse></ink>{{ data.lage.runningText }} <ink tone=danger run="todos-ext.board-run" with="stop=true" into="ran" emit="todos-changed" tip="Cancel the run — the step it is on (sync, AI) ends with it">Cancel</ink></line>{{/if}}
<splitbutton label="{{ data.lage.running ? 'Running…' : 'Run now' }}" disabled="{{ data.lage.running }}" run="todos-ext.board-run" with="stop=false" into="ran" emit="todos-changed" tip="First syncs what AI steps → “Sync first” lists, then reads your tickets (with comments and history) and what Zeff knows about them, has the AI from the settings write the briefing and the todos — and then matches each todo with the mails it is about" menutip="The run's steps — how they last ran, each one startable on its own">
<line look=stepsnote>“Run now” does these steps one after another — each also works on its own.</line>
<rows>
{{#each data.lage.steps}}
<listrow><ink tone=grow><ink href="{{ href }}" tip="{{ what }}" tone=medium>{{ label }}</ink><line look=sub>{{#if failed}}✗ {{else}}{{#if ok}}✓ {{/if}}{{/if}}{{ text }}</line>{{#if health}}<line look=warnline>{{ health }}</line>{{/if}}</ink>{{#if running}}<iconbtn glyph="■" label="Cancel" tip="Cancel — what it started ends with it" run="todos-ext.sync" with="key={{ key }}, stop=true" emit="todos-changed"/>{{#else}}<iconbtn glyph="⟳" label="{{ label }} now" tip="{{ label }} now — {{ what }}" run="todos-ext.sync" with="key={{ key }}, stop=false" into="synced" emit="todos-changed"/>{{/if}}</listrow>
{{/each}}
</rows>
</splitbutton>
</line>
{{#if data.synced.error}}<line look=error>{{ data.synced.error }}</line>{{/if}}
{{#if data.ran.message}}{{#if not data.ran.ok}}<line look=error>{{ data.ran.message }}</line>{{/if}}{{/if}}
</line>
</line>
{{#if data.lage.failed}}<line look=alert>{{ data.lage.failed }}</line>{{/if}}

{{/if}}
</sidebar>
{{#if state.part == 'todos'}}
{{#if state.scope != 'activity' and not data.x}}<line look=empty>Loading …</line>{{#else}}
<card flush=phone>
<segmented bind="scope" label="Todos" options='[["open","Your todos","{{ data.x.counts.open }}"],["done","Done","{{ data.x.counts.done }}"],["worker","Worker","{{ data.x.counts.worker }}"],["activity","Activity"]]'/>
{{#if state.scope == 'activity'}}
<line look=lines>
<line look=bar>
<pill look=filter on="{{ state.feedfilter == 'all' }}" action="state" state="feedfilter" value="all">{{ data.feed.labels.all }}</pill>
<pill look=filter on="{{ state.feedfilter == 'closed' }}" action="state" state="feedfilter" value="closed">{{ data.feed.labels.closed }}</pill>
<pill look=filter on="{{ state.feedfilter == 'created' }}" action="state" state="feedfilter" value="created">{{ data.feed.labels.created }}</pill>
{{#if data.feed.unseenText}}<ink tone="amber">{{ data.feed.unseenText }}</ink>{{/if}}
</line>
{{#if data.feed}}{{#if not data.feed.days}}<line look=empty>{{ data.feed.empty }}</line>{{/if}}{{/if}}
{{#each data.feed.days}}
<line look=section>
<line look=caption>{{ label }}</line>
<rows>
{{#each items}}
<listrow tone="{{ isNew ? 'new' : 'plain' }}">
<ink tone=time>{{ time }}</ink>
<ink tone="event {{ tone }}">{{ icon }} {{ label }}</ink>
<ink tone=grow>
<line look=block>{{#if isNew}}<ink tone=dot tip="new"></ink> {{/if}}<ink tone="{{ closedEvent ? 'zinc' : '' }}">{{ text }}</ink></line>
<line look=sub><ink tone=code action="state" state="panel" value="{{ todoId }}">{{ ref }}</ink> · {{ ticket }} · {{#if byHref}}<ink tone=muted href="{{ byHref }}" tip="{{ byTitle }}">{{ by }}</ink>{{#else}}<ink tone=muted tip="{{ byTitle }}">{{ by }}</ink>{{/if}}{{#if reopened}} · reopened{{/if}}{{#if run}} · <ink tone=muted run="todos-ext.undo-run" with="run={{ run }}" into="undone" confirm="Dismiss the todos this run made that you haven't touched — those you worked on stay" emit="todos-changed" tip="Dismiss the todos this run made that you haven't touched — those you worked on stay">take back the run</ink>{{/if}}</line>
{{#if note}}<line look=subnote>{{ note }}</line>{{/if}}
</ink>
</listrow>
{{/each}}
</rows>
</line>
{{/each}}
{{#if data.undone.message}}<line look=small>{{ data.undone.message }}</line>{{/if}}
</line>

{{#else}}
<line look=tools>
<searchfield bind="omniq" placeholder="{{ data.x.chips ? 'and …' : 'Search todos, tickets, mails, comments, notes, people …' }}" label="Search the todos and everything they are made of" enter="omni-first" back="omni-back">
{{#each data.x.chips}}<token label="{{ title }}" remove="Remove this filter" action="pick" state="chips" value="{{ pick }}"/>{{/each}}
<popover>
{{#if data.hits.none}}<option empty=true label="{{ data.hits.none }}"/>{{/if}}
{{#if not data.hits}}<option empty=true label="Searching …"/>{{/if}}
{{#each data.hits.hits}}{{#if first}}<optgroup label="{{ label }}"/>{{/if}}<option icon="{{ icon }}" label="{{ title }}" sub="{{ sub }}" meta="{{ n }}" action="pick" state="chips" value="{{ pick }}"/>{{/each}}
</popover>
</searchfield>
<on event="omni-first" action="pick" state="chips" value="{{ data.hits.first }}"/><on event="omni-back" action="pop" state="chips"/>
{{#if data.x.chips}}<ink tone="link quiet" action="state" state="chips" value="[]">Clear the filter</ink>{{/if}}
{{#if state.filter}}<ink tone="link quiet" action="state" state="filter" value="">Clear the filter</ink>{{/if}}
</line>

{{#if data.st.confirm}}
<callout tone=warn>
<text>{{ data.st.confirm }}</text>
<button run="todos-ext.status" with="id={{ data.st.id }}, status=done, early=true" into="st" emit="todos-changed" label="Mark it done" variant=primary/>
</callout>
{{/if}}
{{#if data.st.error}}{{#if not data.st.confirm}}<line look=error>{{ data.st.error }}</line>{{/if}}{{/if}}
{{#if state.scope == 'open'}}
{{#if data.x.groups}}
<line look=groups>
{{#each data.x.groups}}
<line look="block">
<caption dot="{{ color }}" n="{{ count }}" tone="{{ overdue ? 'bad' : 'plain' }}">{{ label }}</caption>
<checklist>
{{#each items}}
<checkrow id="todo-{{ id }}" label="{{ doneTip }}" checked="{{ done or suggested }}" look="{{ suggested ? 'suggest' : 'plain' }}" tone="{{ asking ? 'ask' : suggested ? 'suggest' : reported ? 'good' : workRun ? 'busy' : isNew ? 'new' : deferred ? 'dim' : 'plain' }}" tip="{{ askingTip }}" checktip="{{ suggestedTip }}" run="todos-ext.status" with="id={{ id }}, status={{ closed ? 'open' : 'done' }}" into="st" emit="todos-changed">
<line look="{{ closed ? 'struck' : waiting ? 'aside' : 'lead' }}">{{#if flagged}}<ink tone=flag glyph=flag-sm tip="important"></ink>{{/if}}{{#if asking}}<ink tone=sign tip="{{ askingTip }}">❗</ink>{{/if}}{{#if waiting}}{{#if not closed}}<ink tone=lead tip="Waiting for others">⏳</ink>{{/if}}{{/if}}{{#each textParts}}{{#if ticket}}{{#if url}}<ink tone=mono href="{{ url }}" tip="{{ tip }}">{{ ticket }}</ink>{{#else}}<ink tone=code>{{ ticket }}</ink>{{/if}}{{/if}}{{#if tref}}<ink tone="code link" href="{{ href }}" tip="{{ tip }}">{{ tref }}</ink>{{/if}}{{#if mr}}<ink tone=mono href="{{ url }}" tip="{{ tip }}">{{ mr }}</ink>{{/if}}{{#if s}}{{ s }}{{/if}}{{/each}}</line>
{{#if statusLabel}}<ink tone=label hover="Reopen" grace=3.5 undo="Undo reopen" pending=unstrike tip="Open it again — back into your todos" run="todos-ext.status" with="id={{ id }}, status=open" into="st" emit="todos-changed">{{ statusLabel }}</ink>{{/if}}
<line look=meta><copytext text="{{ ref }}" tip="{{ copyTip }}"/>{{#if workRun}} · <ink tone=link href="{{ workRun }}" tip="Open the run working on it on the Code tab">{{ workRef }}</ink>{{/if}}{{#if originShort}} · <ink tip="{{ origin }}">{{ originShort }}</ink>{{/if}}{{#if ticket}} · {{#if ticketUrl}}<ink tone=mono href="{{ ticketUrl }}" tip="{{ ticketTitle }}">{{ ticket }} ↗</ink>{{#else}}<ink tone=code>{{ ticket }}</ink>{{/if}}{{#each also}}<ink tip="Linked ticket — it's about the same thing"> + {{#if url}}<ink tone=mono href="{{ url }}">{{ key }} ↗</ink>{{#else}}<ink tone=code>{{ key }}</ink>{{/if}}</ink>{{/each}}{{/if}}{{#each mrs}} · <ink tone="code link" href="{{ url }}" tip="{{ tip }}">{{ label }}</ink>{{#if tag}}<ink tone=faint> ({{ tag }})</ink>{{/if}}{{/each}} · {{ kind }}{{#if due}}<pill tone="{{ duePill }}" action="state" state="quick" value="{{ closed ? '' : qDue }}" then="dueval={{ due }}" tip="{{ dueTip }}">{{ dueLabel }}</pill>{{#else}}{{#if not closed}}<pill look=ghost action="state" state="quick" value="{{ qDue }}" then="dueval=" tip="{{ dueTip }}">+ due date</pill>{{/if}}{{/if}}{{#if repeat}} · <ink action="state" state="quick" value="{{ state.quick == qRepeat ? '' : qRepeat }}" tip="{{ repeatTip }}">↻ {{ repeat }}</ink>{{#if due}}<ink href="/api/todos/{{ id }}/calendar" tip="Show it in the calendar"> 📅</ink>{{/if}}{{#if not closed}}<ink tone=reveal run="todos-ext.regenerate" with="id={{ id }}" into="regen" emit="todos-changed" tip="Make the calendar appointments and the actions again"> make again</ink>{{/if}}{{#else}}{{#if not closed}}<ink tone=reveal action="state" state="quick" value="{{ state.quick == qRepeat ? '' : qRepeat }}" tip="{{ repeatTip }}"> · repeat</ink>{{/if}}{{/if}}{{#if merged}} · <ink tone=violet tip="{{ mergedTip }}">{{ merged }}</ink>{{/if}}{{#if time}} · <ink action="state" state="quick" value="{{ state.quick == qTime ? '' : qTime }}" tip="Time records — click for them">{{ time }}</ink>{{/if}}{{#if pathLabel}} · {{ pathLabel }}{{/if}}{{#if reported}}<ink tone=good tip="{{ reportedTip }}"> · ✓ {{ reported }}</ink>{{/if}}{{#if suggested}}<ink tone=muted tip="{{ suggestedTip }}"> · ✓ {{ suggested }}</ink>{{/if}}{{#if deferred}}<ink tone=faint> · deferred</ink>{{/if}}{{#if backUp}}<ink tone=warn tip="You had moved it down — it's back on top"> · {{ backUp }}</ink>{{/if}}{{#each away}}<ink tone=warn tip="Read from their messages — a question to them waits until they are back"> · 🏖 {{ text }}</ink>{{/each}}</line>
{{#if state.quick == qRepeat}}<line look=meta>Repeat: <ink run="todos-ext.recurrence" with="id={{ id }}, freq=" then="quick=" emit="todos-changed">does not repeat</ink> · <ink run="todos-ext.recurrence" with="id={{ id }}, freq=daily" emit="todos-changed">every day</ink> · <ink run="todos-ext.recurrence" with="id={{ id }}, freq=weekly" emit="todos-changed">every week</ink> · <ink run="todos-ext.recurrence" with="id={{ id }}, freq=monthly" emit="todos-changed">every month</ink> · <ink run="todos-ext.recurrence" with="id={{ id }}, freq=yearly" emit="todos-changed">every year</ink> · <ink action="state" state="quick" value="">close</ink></line>{{/if}}
{{#if state.quick == qDue}}<line look=meta><input bind="dueval" type=date label="Due date"/><button run="todos-ext.due" with="id={{ id }}, due={{ state.dueval }}" then="quick=" emit="todos-changed" label="Save" variant=primary disabled="{{ not state.dueval }}"/>{{#if due}}<ink run="todos-ext.due" with="id={{ id }}, due=" then="quick=" emit="todos-changed">no due date</ink>{{/if}}<ink action="state" state="quick" value="">cancel</ink></line>{{/if}}
{{#if state.quick == qNote}}
<inset>
<input bind="newnote" type=textarea rows=2 placeholder="{{ notePlaceholder }}"/>
<line look=between><line look=faint>Goes as context to the briefing, workers and agents. Ctrl+Enter · paste or drop pictures here</line><row gap=1 wrap=true align=center><upload bind="busy" run="documents.add" with="todo={{ id }}" accept="image/*" multiple=true variant=plain label="🖼 Picture" done="Image attached — the AI will know it." emit="todos-changed"/>{{#if state.newnote}}<button action="state" state="newnote" value="" label="Discard" tip="Delete the draft"/>{{/if}}<button action="state" state="quick" value="" label="Close" tip="Close — the draft stays"/><button run="todos-ext.note" with="id={{ id }}, text={{ state.newnote }}" into="noted" then="newnote=; quick=" emit="todos-changed" label="Save note" variant=primary disabled="{{ not state.newnote }}"/></row></line>
</inset>
{{/if}}
{{#if state.quick == qAi}}
<inset>
<line look=tools><pill look=shortcut run="todos-ext.suggest" with="id={{ id }}" into="sugg" then="quick=" emit="todos-changed" tip="The AI now makes ready-made actions for this todo (message, comment, mail, meeting…)">✨ Suggest actions</pill><pill look=shortcut action="state" state="instr" value="Entwirf die Antwort oder Nachricht, um die es in {{ ref }} geht — fertig formuliert, als followUp mit Entwurf (channel, target) und ggf. als Operation. Nichts senden." tip="Instruction: draft the reply or message it is about">✨ Draft a reply</pill><pill look=shortcut action="state" state="instr" value="Fass zusammen, worum es in {{ ref }} geht: was der Stand ist, wer was zuletzt gesagt hat, was offen ist und was der nächste Schritt wäre. Nichts ändern." tip="Instruction: where it stands and the next step">✨ Summarize</pill><pill look=shortcut action="state" state="instr" value="Sieh im Repo und im Kontext nach, was für {{ ref }} wichtig ist (betroffene Stellen, Ursachen, offene Fragen), und berichte. Nichts ändern." tip="Instruction: look in the repo and the context and report">✨ Research</pill></line>
<input bind="instr" type=textarea rows=3 placeholder="{{ aiPlaceholder }}"/>
<line look=between><line look=faint>Copilot CLI gets the todo with all its context; the result shows on the Code tab. Ctrl+Enter</line><row gap=1 wrap=true align=center>{{#if state.instr}}<button action="state" state="instr" value="" label="Discard" tip="Delete the draft"/>{{/if}}<button action="state" state="quick" value="" label="Close" tip="Close — the draft stays"/><button run="todos-ext.instruct" with="id={{ id }}, text={{ state.instr }}" into="instd" then="instr=; quick=" emit="todos-changed" label="To Copilot" variant=primary disabled="{{ not state.instr }}"/></row></line>
</inset>
{{/if}}
{{#if state.quick == qTime}}
<inset small=true>
{{#each data.qp.time}}<line look=tools><ink tone="code" tip="{{ note }}">{{ length }}</ink><ink tone=grow>{{ note }}<ink tone=faint> · {{ by }} · {{ when }}</ink></ink>{{#if mine}}<iconbtn glyph=x run="todos-ext.time-delete" with="id={{ id }}" emit="todos-changed" label="Delete this time record" tip="Delete this time record"/>{{/if}}</line>{{/each}}
<row gap=1 wrap=true align=center><input bind="mins" type=number placeholder="min"/><col fill=true><input bind="timenote" placeholder="What was done (one line)"/></col><button run="todos-ext.time" with="id={{ id }}, minutes={{ state.mins }}, note={{ state.timenote }}" then="mins=; timenote=" emit="todos-changed" label="Add time" variant=primary disabled="{{ not state.mins }}"/><button action="state" state="quick" value="" label="Close"/>{{#if data.qp.timeTotal}}<ink tone=faint>Total {{ data.qp.timeTotal }}</ink>{{/if}}</row>
</inset>
{{/if}}
{{#if state.quick == qReply}}
<inset>
{{#if not data.draft}}<line look=empty>The AI is drafting the reply from the history…</line>{{/if}}
{{#if data.draft.error}}<line look=error>{{ data.draft.error }}</line>{{/if}}
{{#if data.draft.ok}}<input bind="replytext" type=textarea rows=4 value="{{ data.draft.text }}" placeholder="The reply…"/>{{/if}}
<line look=between><line look=faint>{{#if data.draft.to}}To {{ data.draft.to }} · {{ data.draft.channel }}{{#else}}Nothing is sent — you copy it and send it.{{/if}}</line><row gap=1 wrap=true align=center><button run="todos-ext.draft" with="id={{ id }}" into="draft" label="Redraft" tip="Draft again (the current text is replaced)"/>{{#if data.draft.openUrl}}<button run="todos-ext.open-reply" with="url={{ data.draft.openUrl }}" into="opened" label="Open {{ data.draft.channel }}"/>{{/if}}{{#if data.draft.ok}}<copy text="{{ data.draft.text }}" label="Copy"/>{{/if}}<button action="state" state="quick" value="" label="Close"/></row></line>
</inset>
{{/if}}
{{#if state.quick == qPay}}
<inset>
<line look=between><ink tone="strong muted">Pay with GiroCode</ink><ink action="state" state="quick" value="" label="Close">×</ink></line>
{{#if data.qp.payment}}<girocode name="{{ data.qp.payment.name }}" iban="{{ data.qp.payment.iban }}" bic="{{ data.qp.payment.bic }}" amount="{{ data.qp.payment.amount }}" purpose="{{ data.qp.payment.purpose }}"/>{{#else}}<line look=small>No account to pay found — an IBAN in the todo or a note, or the bank account of a person it names (People).</line>{{/if}}
</inset>
{{/if}}
{{#if note}}<line look=note>{{ note }}</line>{{#else}}{{#if source}}<line look=note>{{ source }}</line>{{/if}}{{/if}}
{{#if asking}}<line look=ask><ink tone=strong>Waiting for you:</ink> {{ asking }}</line>{{/if}}
{{#if lastError}}<line look=error><ink tone=grow tip="{{ lastError }}">✗ {{ lastError }}</ink>{{#if errorRun}}<line look=retry><pill look=retry run="todos-ext.run-error" with="run={{ errorRun }}" into="retried" emit="todos-changed" tip="Start the run once more — as it was meant (your ✨ instruction too)">Retry</pill><pill look=hide run="todos-ext.run-error" with="run={{ errorRun }}, hide=true" emit="todos-changed" tip="Hide the error">×</pill></line>{{/if}}</line>{{/if}}
{{#if hasToggles}}<line look=toggles>{{#if ctx}}<sources todo="{{ id }}" summary="{{ ctx }}"/>{{/if}}{{#if opsMode == 'proposed'}}<hover width=420><pill look=area tone=violet glyph=spark on="{{ state.acts == qOps }}" action="state" state="acts" value="{{ state.acts == qOps ? '' : qOps }}">{{ opsAreaLabel }}</pill><hovercard><line look=caption>✨ {{ opsAreaLabel }}</line>{{#each opsCards}}<small>⚡ {{ heading }}</small>{{/each}}{{#if opsWhy}}<small><muted>{{ opsWhy }}</muted></small>{{/if}}<small><muted>{{ opsHint }}</muted></small></hovercard></hover>{{/if}}{{#if opsMode == 'folded'}}<pill look=area glyph=⚡ on="{{ state.acts == qOps }}" action="state" state="acts" value="{{ state.acts == qOps ? {{#if data.p.ticket}}<small><mono>{{ data.p.ticket }}</mono></small>{{/if}}
{{#if data.p.due}}<small><muted>{{ data.p.due }}</muted></small>{{/if}}
{{#if data.p.waiting}}<small><muted>⏳ Waiting for others</muted></small>{{/if}}
</row>
{{#if data.p.note}}<small><muted>{{ data.p.note }}</muted></small>{{#else}}{{#if data.p.source}}<small><muted>{{ data.p.source }}</muted></small>{{/if}}{{/if}}
<row gap=2 wrap=true>
{{#if data.p.closed}}<button run="todos-ext.status" with="id={{ data.p.id }}, status=open" into="st" emit="todos-changed" label="Open again"/>{{#else}}
<button run="todos-ext.status" with="id={{ data.p.id }}, status=done" into="st" then="panel=" emit="todos-changed" label="Done" variant=primary/>
<button run="todos-ext.status" with="id={{ data.p.id }}, status=dismissed" into="st" then="panel=" emit="todos-changed" label="Dismiss — doesn't apply"/>
{{/if}}
</row>
{{#if not data.p.closed}}
<row gap=2 wrap=true>
<button run="todos-ext.draft" with="id={{ data.p.id }}" into="draft" label="Draft a reply" tip="Draft a reply — the AI writes it from the history, you send it"/>
<button run="todos-ext.suggest" with="id={{ data.p.id }}" into="sugg" emit="todos-changed" label="Suggest actions" tip="The AI now makes ready-made actions for this todo (message, comment, mail, meeting…)"/>
<button run="todos-ext.worked-on" with="id={{ data.p.id }}" into="wk" label="Worked on it" tip="A booking suggestion for the todo (its ticket, its recorded time)"/>
</row>
{{#if data.sugg.message}}<small><text tone="{{ data.sugg.ok ? 'good' : 'bad' }}">{{ data.sugg.message }}{{ data.sugg.error }}</text></small>{{/if}}
{{#if data.wk.message}}<small><text tone=good>{{ data.wk.message }}</text></small>{{/if}}
{{#if data.draft.ok}}
<box>
<col gap=2>
<small><muted>To {{ data.draft.to }} · {{ data.draft.channel }}</muted></small>
<text pre=true>{{ data.draft.text }}</text>
<small><muted>Nothing is sent — you copy it and send it.</muted></small>
<row gap=2 wrap=true>
<copy text="{{ data.draft.text }}" label="Copy"/>
{{#if data.draft.openUrl}}<button run="todos-ext.open-reply" with="url={{ data.draft.openUrl }}" into="opened" label="Open {{ data.draft.channel }}" tip="Bring {{ data.draft.channel }} to the front in the automation Chrome"/>{{/if}}
<button run="todos-ext.draft" with="id={{ data.p.id }}" into="draft" label="Draft again" tip="Draft again (the current text is replaced)"/>
</row>
{{#if data.opened.message}}<small><text tone=good>{{ data.opened.message }}</text></small>{{/if}}
{{#if data.opened.error}}<small><text tone=bad>{{ data.opened.error }}</text></small>{{/if}}
</col>
</box>
{{/if}}
{{#if data.draft.error}}<small><text tone=bad>{{ data.draft.error }}</text></small>{{/if}}
<section title="Instruction to Copilot" collapsible=true>
<col gap=2>
<input bind="instr" rows=3 placeholder="What should Copilot do on {{ data.p.ref }}? (e.g. “Check whether this is already done on the branch”)"/>
<row gap=2 wrap=true>
<button run="todos-ext.instruct" with="id={{ data.p.id }}, text={{ state.instr }}" into="instd" then="instr=" emit="todos-changed" label="To Copilot" disabled="{{ not state.instr }}" tip="Copilot CLI gets the todo with all its context; the result shows on the Code tab."/>
<button action="state" state="instr" value="Instruction: look in the repo and the context and report" label="Research" variant=quiet/>
<button action="state" state="instr" value="Instruction: where it stands and the next step" label="Summarize" variant=quiet/>
<button action="state" state="instr" value="Instruction: draft the reply or message it is about" label="Reply" variant=quiet/>
</row>
{{#if data.instd.message}}<small><text tone="{{ data.instd.ok ? 'good' : 'bad' }}">{{ data.instd.message }}{{ data.instd.error }}</text></small>{{/if}}
</col>
</section>
{{/if}}
{{#if data.p.payment}}
<section title="Pay with GiroCode" collapsible=true>
<col gap=2>
<girocode name="{{ data.p.payment.name }}" iban="{{ data.p.payment.iban }}" bic="{{ data.p.payment.bic }}" amount="{{ data.p.payment.amount }}" purpose="{{ data.p.payment.purpose }}"/>
<small><muted>{{ data.p.payment.title }}</muted></small>
<small><muted>{{ data.p.payment.line }}</muted></small>
</col>
</section>
{{/if}}
{{#if data.p.nAlternatives}}{{#if not data.p.closed}}
<section title="Other ways" aside="{{ data.p.nAlternatives }}" collapsible=true open=true>
<col gap=1>
{{#each data.p.alternatives}}<button run="todos-ext.alternative" with="id={{ data.p.id }}, label={{ label }}" into="alt" confirm="{{ title }}?" emit="todos-changed" label="{{ label }}" tip="{{ title }}"/>{{/each}}
{{#if data.alt.message}}<small><text tone=good>{{ data.alt.message }}</text></small>{{/if}}
{{#if data.alt.error}}<small><text tone=bad>{{ data.alt.error }}</text></small>{{/if}}
</col>
</section>
{{/if}}{{/if}}
{{#if data.p.nOps}}
<section title="Actions" aside="{{ data.p.nOps }}" open=true collapsible=true>
<col gap=2>
{{#if data.p.opsWhy}}<small><text tone=muted>{{ data.p.opsWhy }}</text></small>{{/if}}
{{#if data.p.blockedBy}}<small><text tone=warn>{{ data.p.blockedBy }}</text></small>{{/if}}
{{#each data.p.ops}}
<box>
<row gap=2 wrap=false align=start>
<col fill=true gap=1>
<b>⚡ {{ heading }}</b>
{{#if detail}}<small><muted>{{ detail }}</muted></small>{{/if}}
{{#if editBody}}
{{#if state.opedit == only}}
<input bind="optext" rows=5 value="{{ body }}"/>
<row gap=2><button run="todos-ext.op-text" with="id={{ data.p.id }}, index={{ index }}, text={{ state.optext }}" into="opsave" then="opedit=" emit="todos-changed" label="Save" variant=primary disabled="{{ not state.optext }}"/><button action="state" state="opedit" value="" label="Cancel"/></row>
{{#else}}
<text pre=true>{{ body }}</text>
<button action="state" state="opedit" value="{{ only }}" then="optext={{ body }}" label="✎" variant=quiet tip="Change the text before it is sent"/>
{{/if}}
{{#else}}{{#if body}}<text pre=true>{{ body }}</text>{{/if}}{{/if}}
{{#if transfer}}{{#if not data.p.closed}}
<section title="Transfer" collapsible=true>
<col gap=1>
<input bind="tf_name" label="Name" value="{{ transfer.name }}"/>
<input bind="tf_iban" label="IBAN" value="{{ transfer.iban }}"/>
<grid cols=3 gap=2 min=120><input bind="tf_bic" label="BIC" value="{{ transfer.bic }}"/><input bind="tf_amount" label="Amount" value="{{ transfer.amount }}"/><input bind="tf_purpose" label="Purpose" value="{{ transfer.purpose }}"/></grid>
<button run="todos-ext.transfer" with="id={{ data.p.id }}, index={{ index }}, name={{ state.tf_name }}, iban={{ state.tf_iban }}, bic={{ state.tf_bic }}, amount={{ state.tf_amount }}, purpose={{ state.tf_purpose }}" into="opsave" emit="todos-changed" label="Save" variant=primary/>
</col>
</section>
{{/if}}{{/if}}
{{#if href}}<row gap=2 wrap=true><small><a href="{{ href }}">Open ↗</a></small>{{#if not data.p.closed}}<button run="todos-ext.browser-done" with="id={{ data.p.id }}, index={{ index }}" into="opsave" emit="todos-changed" label="Done in the browser" variant=quiet tip="You did it yourself: taken off the todo and noted"/>{{/if}}</row>{{/if}}
</col>
{{#if not data.p.closed}}
{{#if runnable}}<button run="todos-ext.run" with="id={{ data.p.id }}, only={{ only }}" into="ran" confirm="Zeff does it itself, no AI" emit="todos-changed" label="Run" variant=primary/>{{/if}}
<button run="todos-ext.op-remove" with="id={{ data.p.id }}, index={{ index }}" emit="todos-changed" label="✕" variant=quiet tip="Remove this action"/>
{{/if}}
</row>
</box>
{{/each}}
{{#if data.p.manyRunnable}}{{#if not data.p.closed}}<button run="todos-ext.run" with="id={{ data.p.id }}" into="ran" emit="todos-changed" label="Run all" variant=primary/>{{/if}}{{/if}}
{{#if data.ran.message}}<text tone=good>{{ data.ran.message }}</text>{{/if}}
{{#if data.opsave.message}}<small><text tone=good>{{ data.opsave.message }}</text></small>{{/if}}
{{#if data.opsave.error}}<small><text tone=bad>{{ data.opsave.error }}</text></small>{{/if}}
</col>
</section>
{{/if}}
<section title="Notes" aside="{{ data.p.nNotes }}" open=true collapsible=true>
<col gap=2>
{{#each data.p.notes}}
<box>
<row gap=2 wrap=false align=start>
<col fill=true gap=1>
<small><muted>{{#if by}}{{ by }} · {{/if}}{{ when }}</muted></small>
{{#if state.noteedit == at}}
<input bind="notetext" rows=4 value="{{ text }}"/>
<row gap=2><button run="todos-ext.note-edit" with="id={{ data.p.id }}, at={{ at }}, text={{ state.notetext }}" then="noteedit=" emit="todos-changed" label="Save" variant=primary disabled="{{ not state.notetext }}"/><button action="state" state="noteedit" value="" label="Cancel"/></row>
{{#else}}
{{#each parts}}{{#if image}}<a href="{{ url }}"><img src="{{ url }}" alt="{{ title }}"/></a>{{#else}}<text pre=true>{{ text }}</text>{{/if}}{{/each}}
{{/if}}
{{#if url}}<small><a href="{{ url }}">{{ urlLabel }} ↗</a></small>{{/if}}
{{#if sync}}<small><muted>{{ sync }}</muted></small>{{/if}}
</col>
{{#if mine}}<button action="state" state="noteedit" value="{{ at }}" then="notetext={{ text }}" label="✎" variant=quiet tip="Change the note"/>
{{#if data.p.ticket}}<button run="todos-ext.note-sync" with="id={{ data.p.id }}, at={{ at }}" into="jira" confirm="Put this note on {{ data.p.ticket }} in Jira as a comment?" emit="todos-changed" label="Jira" variant=quiet tip="Put the note on the ticket in Jira as a comment"/>{{/if}}{{/if}}
{{#if mine}}<button run="todos-ext.note-remove" with="id={{ data.p.id }}, at={{ at }}" emit="todos-changed" label="✕" variant=quiet tip="Remove this note"/>{{/if}}
</row>
</box>
{{/each}}
<input bind="newnote" rows=3 placeholder="Note on {{ data.p.ref }} — what you know, what applies, what's already settled… (@ tags people)"/>
{{#if data.men.hits}}<row gap=1 wrap=true>{{#each data.men.hits}}<button action="state" state="newnote" value="{{ next }}" label="@{{ name }}" variant=quiet tip="{{ jira }}"/>{{/each}}</row>{{/if}}
{{#if data.p.nImages}}<row gap=1 wrap=true><small><muted>Add a picture</muted></small>{{#each data.p.attachments}}{{#if image}}<button action="state" state="newnote" value="{{ state.newnote }}{{ insert }}" label="🖼 {{ name }}" variant=quiet/>{{/if}}{{/each}}</row>{{/if}}
<row gap=2>
<button run="todos-ext.note" with="id={{ data.p.id }}, text={{ state.newnote }}" into="noted" then="newnote=" emit="todos-changed" label="Save note" variant=primary disabled="{{ not state.newnote }}"/>
</row>
{{#if data.jira.message}}<small><text tone=good>{{ data.jira.message }}</text></small>{{/if}}
{{#if data.jira.error}}<small><text tone=bad>{{ data.jira.error }}</text></small>{{/if}}
{{#if data.noted.message}}<small><text tone=good>{{ data.noted.message }}</text></small>{{/if}}
</col>
</section>
<section title="Time" aside="{{ data.p.totalTime }}" collapsible=true open=true>
<col gap=2>
{{#each data.p.time}}
<row gap=2 wrap=false align=baseline><b>{{ length }}</b><col fill=true><small>{{ note }}</small><small><muted>{{ by }} · {{ when }}</muted></small></col>{{#if mine}}<button run="todos-ext.time-delete" with="id={{ id }}" emit="todos-changed" label="✕" variant=quiet tip="Remove this record"/>{{/if}}</row>
{{/each}}
<row gap=2 wrap=true align=end>
<input bind="mins" type=number placeholder="Add time you spent on this todo"/>
<col fill=true><input bind="timenote" placeholder="What was done"/></col>
<button run="todos-ext.time" with="id={{ data.p.id }}, minutes={{ state.mins }}, note={{ state.timenote }}" then="mins=" emit="todos-changed" label="Add time" disabled="{{ not state.mins }}"/>
</row>
</col>
</section>
{{#if data.p.mrs}}
<section title="Merge requests" collapsible=true open=true>
<col gap=1>{{#each data.p.mrs}}<small><a href="{{ url }}">MR {{ ref }} ↗</a> <muted>{{ title }}{{#if state}} ({{ state }}){{/if}}</muted></small>{{/each}}</col>
</section>
{{/if}}
{{#if data.p.nPlanned}}
<section title="Path" collapsible=true>
<col gap=1>{{#each data.p.planned}}{{#if path}}<small><b>{{ path }}</b></small>{{/if}}{{#each steps}}<small>→ {{ text }} <muted>({{ kind }})</muted></small>{{/each}}{{/each}}</col>
</section>
{{/if}}
{{#if not data.p.closed}}
<section title="Attach a document" collapsible=true>
<col gap=2>
{{#if data.pick_error}}<small><muted>The Documents plugin is not installed (Menu → Plugins).</muted></small>{{#else}}
<row gap=2 align=center>
<col fill=true><search bind="aq" placeholder="Search the documents …"/></col>
<upload bind="busy" run="documents.add" with="todo={{ data.p.id }}" multiple=true label="Upload new …" done="Attached — being read …" emit="todos-changed"/>
</row>
<small><muted>An attached document is context for this todo.</muted></small>
{{#each data.pick.items}}
<row gap=2 align=start wrap=false>
<text>{{ icon }}</text>
<col fill=true><b>{{ title }}</b> <small><muted>{{ sizeText }}</muted></small><small><muted>{{ text }}</muted></small></col>
<button run="documents.attach" with="todo={{ data.p.id }}, doc={{ id }}" done="Attached." emit="todos-changed" label="Attach"/>
</row>
{{/each}}
{{/if}}
</col>
</section>
{{/if}}
{{#if data.p.nKnowledge}}
<section title="Knowledge" aside="{{ data.p.nKnowledge }}" collapsible=true>
<col gap=1>
{{#if data.p.knowledge.repo}}<box><b>{{ data.p.knowledge.repo.name }}</b><markdown value="{{ data.p.knowledge.repo.summary }}"/></box>{{/if}}
{{#each data.p.knowledge.pages}}<small><a href="{{ url }}">{{ title }} ↗</a> <muted>{{ snippet }}</muted></small>{{/each}}
{{#each data.p.knowledge.entities}}<small><b>{{ name }}</b> <muted>{{ type }} — {{ summary }}</muted></small>{{/each}}
{{#each data.p.knowledge.links}}<small><a href="{{ url }}">{{ label }} ↗</a></small>{{/each}}
</col>
</section>
{{/if}}
{{#if data.p.nSources}}
<section title="Context" aside="{{ data.p.nSources }}" collapsible=true open=true>
<col gap=2>
{{#each data.p.sources}}
<box>
<hover width=520><chip>{{ label }}</chip><hovercard><small><muted>{{ author }} {{ when }}</muted></small>{{#if headline}}<b>{{ headline }}</b>{{/if}}{{#if text}}<text pre=true>{{ text }}</text>{{/if}}</hovercard></hover>
<small><muted>{{#if author}}{{ author }} · {{/if}}{{ when }}</muted></small>
{{#if headline}}<b>{{ headline }}</b>{{/if}}
{{#if text}}<text pre=true>{{ text }}</text>{{/if}}
{{#if not data.p.closed}}<button run="todos-ext.context-dismiss" with="id={{ data.p.id }}, ref={{ ref }}" emit="todos-changed" label="✕" variant=quiet tip="Not about this todo"/>{{/if}}
</box>
{{/each}}
</col>
</section>
{{/if}}
</col>
{{#else}}
<muted>Loading …</muted>
{{/if}}
</dialog>

items.title: Tick a todo off, dismiss it, open it again

flow.name: todos-ext.status
flow.title: Tick a todo off, dismiss it, open it again
flow.description: A todo's status (input id, status: open | done | dismissed, early). Output { ok, id, confirm, error } — confirm: a repeat ticked off a week or more before its day asks first.

flow.name: todos-ext.flag
flow.title: Flag a todo as important
flow.description: A todo flagged important or not (input id, flagged).

items.title: Set a todo aside — or back up

flow.name: todos-ext.defer
flow.title: Set a todo aside — or back up
flow.description: A todo put to the bottom for now or taken back up (input id, deferred).

flow.name: todos-ext.due
flow.title: A todo's due day
flow.description: A todo's due day (input id, due: YYYY-MM-DD, empty for none).

flow.name: todos-ext.add
flow.title: Add a todo
flow.description: A todo of yours through the gate every todo goes through (input text, ticket, due). Output { id, ref, merged } — merged: it said the same as an open one.

flow.name: todos-ext.text
flow.title: A todo's words
flow.description: A todo's text changed (input id, text).

flow.name: todos-ext.note
flow.title: A note on a todo
flow.description: Your note on a todo (input id, text). Output { ok, message, error }.

items.title: Take a note off a todo

flow.name: todos-ext.note-remove
flow.title: Take a note off a todo
flow.description: Your note on a todo taken away (input id, at: the note's time).

flow.name: todos-ext.time
flow.title: Time spent on a todo
flow.description: Time you spent, by hand (input id, minutes, note).

items.title: Take an action off a todo

flow.name: todos-ext.op-remove
flow.title: Take an action off a todo
flow.description: One of a todo's actions taken off it (input id, index).

items.title: The activity you have looked at

flow.name: todos-ext.seen
flow.title: The activity you have looked at
flow.description: The newest event of the todos' activity you have seen (input id).

flow.name: todos-ext.undo-run
flow.title: Take back a briefing run's todos

flow.name: todos-ext.board-run
flow.title: Run the briefing now — or stop it
flow.description: The Ticket-Lage's run started (Jira synced first) or, with stop, stopped. Output { ok, message }.

flow.title: A change the briefing suggests on a ticket

flow.name: todos-ext.follow
flow.title: Follow a ticket
flow.description: A ticket followed (1), no longer followed (-1) or as it comes (0) (input key, value).

items.title: Write the recap of a day

flow.name: todos-ext.recap-start
flow.title: Write the recap of a day
flow.description: The day gathered and summarized by the AI, in the background (input day). Output { ok, message }.

flow.name: todos-ext.recurrence
flow.title: Make a todo come back
flow.description: A todo that comes back every day, week, month or year, or not (input id, freq: daily | weekly | monthly | yearly | empty).

items.title: Make a repeat's appointments and actions again

flow.name: todos-ext.regenerate
flow.title: Make a repeat's appointments and actions again
flow.description: A recurring todo's calendar appointments and its actions made again (input id). Output { ok, message }.

flow.name: todos-ext.note-edit
flow.title: Change a note
flow.description: Your note on a todo changed (input id, at, text).

flow.name: todos-ext.note-sync
flow.title: Put a note on Jira
flow.description: Your note on a todo posted on its ticket as a comment (input id, at). Output { ok, message, error }.

flow.name: todos-ext.instruct
flow.title: An instruction to Copilot
flow.description: Your instruction on a todo done by the Copilot CLI (input id, text). Output { ok, message, error }.

flow.name: todos-ext.draft
flow.title: Draft a reply
flow.description: A reply drafted by the AI from the conversation, never sent (input id). Output { ok, text, channel, to, openUrl, error }.

items.title: Bring a reply's page to the front

flow.name: todos-ext.open-reply
flow.title: Bring a reply's page to the front
flow.description: The page a reply goes to brought to the front in the automation Chrome (input url).

flow.name: todos-ext.suggest
flow.title: The AI proposes actions
flow.description: The AI proposes the actions for a todo now (input id). Output { ok, message, error }.

flow.name: todos-ext.alternative
flow.title: Do a todo another way
flow.description: One of a todo's other ways done (input id, label). Output { ok, message, error }.

flow.name: todos-ext.worked-on
flow.title: Worked on it
flow.description: A booking suggestion for the todo (input id). Output { ok, message }.

items.title: Take a time record off a todo

flow.name: todos-ext.time-delete
flow.title: Take a time record off a todo
flow.description: A time record taken away (input id: the record's).

items.title: Take a context off a todo

flow.name: todos-ext.context-dismiss
flow.title: Take a context off a todo
flow.description: What a todo is shown to come from taken off it (input id, ref).

items.title: Change the text an action would send

flow.name: todos-ext.op-text
flow.title: Change the text an action would send
flow.description: The text of one of a todo's actions changed (input id, index, text). Output { ok, message, error }.

flow.name: todos-ext.transfer
flow.title: Change a transfer's fields
flow.description: A transfer on a todo changed (input id, index, name, iban, bic, amount, purpose). Output { ok, message, error }.

items.title: The todos you have looked at

flow.name: todos-ext.list-seen
flow.title: The todos you have looked at
flow.description: Now is kept as the time up to which you have seen the todos (what is newer shows as new).

items.title: An action done in your browser

flow.name: todos-ext.browser-done
flow.title: An action done in your browser
flow.description: An action you did yourself taken off the todo and noted (input id, index). Output { ok, message, error }.

flow.name: todos-ext.ask
flow.title: Ask about a ticket
flow.description: A question about a ticket answered from what Zeff knows (input ticket, question). Output { ok, answer, sources, id, error }.

items.title: Take an answer out of a ticket's chat

flow.title: Take an answer out of a ticket's chat
flow.description: An answer taken out of the context (input id).

flow.name: todos-ext.resolve
flow.title: A comment done — or not
flow.description: A Jira or GitLab comment marked done here or taken back (input kind: jira | gitlab, key, ticket, resolved).

flow.title: Which tickets the briefing reads

items.title: Run a sync step — or stop it

flow.title: Run a sync step — or stop it
flow.description: One of Zeff's sync steps started or stopped (input key, stop). Output { ok, message, error }.

items.title: A failed run on a todo again — or its error put away

flow.title: A failed run on a todo again — or its error put away
